raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "start working at"
      role subject "Mr Nilsen"
      role object "Atelier Neagu"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "start working at"
      role subject "Doina"
      role object "Atelier Neagu"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  order ?t2 before ?t1
